quest.title: Scent on the Wind
quest.description: As you walk through Mondstadt, Paimon is attracted by the aroma of food...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmmm! The aroma is coming from Good Hunter!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A thick slice of soft white toast...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Topped with a generous serving of onion slices, lightly caramelized by the toasting... Yum yum!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's an emergency! We must order ourselves a generous serving of <color=#00E1FFFF>Fisherman's Toast</color> from <color=#00E1FFFF>Good Hunter</color>, pronto!

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon before the purchase
Talk to Paimon after the purchase

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good Hunter's Fisherman's Toast is the best!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This might surprise you, but it's actually a classic Mondstadt recipe that anyone can cook.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can try cooking it yourself if you have the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Can {NICKNAME}'s cooking skills surpass that of Good Hunter's?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why, Paimon would love to be your personal taster!
